scope: Data structure and static progression reachability, not runtime playtest or asset rendering.
assumptions: Successful captures are eventually achieved through repeatable attempts.
Free camps and renewable battles/caches permit repeatable training, healing and evolution-item purchases.
Each encountered family can be caught repeatedly; evolved ancestors remain registered.
Time advances in the field; resting changes weather and advances six hours.
Mew additionally requires the attainable west-north-east memory-stone interaction sequence.
